target.title: fix(google-meet): bound attendance grace minutes so late checks stay …
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Google Meet attendance late/early annotation used `(params.lateAfterMinutes ?? 5) * 60_000` (and the early equivalent). Oversized or float CLI/tool values could turn grace into `Infinity`, which makes `late` / `earlyLeave` always false even when the participant was clearly outside any reasonable window.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Cap decoration grace at **1..1440** minutes via `resolveAttendanceGraceMinutes` so `graceMs` stays finite (default remains 5).
- Reject float / zero / oversized CLI `--late-after-minutes` / `--early-before-minutes` before Meet API fetches.
- Reject tool params above the same max via `readPositiveIntegerParam`.
- No new config or env surface.

## User Impact

**Before:** Oversized or fractional grace input could silently disable late/early detection.

**After:** CLI/tool reject invalid grace flags; decoration clamps oversized values so late/early checks stay finite. Valid small integers (including the default of 5) are unchanged.

## Evidence

**Branch / SHA:** `fix/google-meet-attendance-minutes` @ `d899c4e5302dc2174b8394aa6a510961378ce508`  
**Runtime:** Node `v22.22.0`, Vitest `v4.1.9`, Darwin arm64  
**Proven claims:**
1. `resolveAttendanceGraceMinutes(1e308) * 60_000` is finite and capped at 1440 minutes.
2. `fetchGoogleMeetAttendance({ lateAfterMinutes: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER })` still marks a >1-day-late join as `late: true`.
3. CLI `--late-after-minutes` values `1.5` / `0` / `100000` throw before any Meet `fetch`.

### Unit + attendance path

**Command:**

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/google-meet/src/attendance-grace.test.ts \
  extensions/google-meet/index.test.ts \
  -t "keeps late detection finite|resolveAttendanceGraceMinutes" \
  --reporter=verbose
```

**Result (re-run 2026-07-14T15:23:14Z):**


### CLI reject path

**Command:**

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/google-meet/src/cli.test.ts \
  -t "rejects invalid attendance grace" \
  --reporter=verbose
```

**Result (re-run 2026-07-14T15:23:23Z):**
